Class IndexWriter.EntrySpec

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.IndexWriter.EntrySpec
Enclosing class:
IndexWriter
public static final class IndexWriter.EntrySpec extends Object
One entry that physically exists in a jar.

Everything but dataOffset(long) is known before the archive is written; the offset is the one value that has to wait for the layout to be fixed.

Since:
1.0

      public IndexWriter.EntrySpec dataOffset(long value)
      Sets the absolute offset of the entry data in the outer archive, that is, past its local file header. For an entry of a nested jar that is the offset of the nested jar plus the entry's offset within it.
      Parameters:
      value - the absolute offset
      Returns:
      this entry

    • dosTime

      public IndexWriter.EntrySpec dosTime(long value)
      Sets the MS-DOS date and time word, as the ZIP headers store it.

      Only the low 32 bits are kept, so an int that went negative because its year pushed a bit into the sign position stores the value it actually holds.

      Parameters:
      value - the packed date and time
      Returns:
      this entry
